name: tendboat
description: Cross-language taint analysis. tendboat indexes the whole repository deterministically and solves taint flows over it; the host agent supplies structure and security judgement per file, as validated JSON. Nothing here calls a model -- the host is the only one.

interface.shortDescription: Remember the parts of the repo you are not looking at, and solve taint flows across them
interface.longDescription: Indexes the whole repository with tree-sitter, keeps the IR the host agent describes, and solves taint flows over it with IFDS. Finds injection, secret-leak, path-traversal, SSRF, deserialization and missing-authorization defects that cross a file, a language or a process boundary. Starts no model.
defaultPrompt: Are there defects in my commit?
